_metadata.description: Read-only source distribution visibility backed by scenario-to-repository

requirements.title: Expose authoritative source distributions without taking ownership
requirements.description: The workspace lists and opens durable source-ramp distributions, preserves the complete evidence tuple, distinguishes contents/exclusions/obligations, and keeps approval, publication, destination read-back, freshness, and drift separate. The projection remains read-only and reports unavailable evidence honestly.

validation.notes: Covers exact identity preservation, approval/publication/drift separation, safe exclusions, and typed unavailable responses.
Covers tuple, contents, exclusions, handoff, drift, and owner-unavailable states.
